output: A Russian SU-27 fighter jet aggressively manoeuvred around a US RC-135U intelligence-gathering plane in international airspace over the Sea of Okhotsk, exposing its belly to demonstrate it was armed with air-to-air missiles.
Charles and Camilla will embark on a 12-day tour of Australia and New Zealand, visiting various towns and cities, including meeting the new Australian PM Malcolm Turnbull.
A woman in her 70s was attacked in Sneem, County Kerry, and a man is being questioned at Killarney Garda station in connection with the incident.
Hugh McGoldrick's name will be removed from the medical register after the Medical Practitioners Tribunal did not receive any confirmation of his appeal within the 28-day deadline.

The man, who has not been formally identified, was discovered in a wooded area near Dorking, while Surrey Police awaits the results of a post-mortem examination after questioning a 21-year-old male arrested on suspicion of murder.
Josh Hanson was fatally stabbed in the neck at the RE bar in Eastcote, Hillingdon, London, and police are urging around 40 witnesses to come forward with information.
Hovertravel is considering adding a new service between Sandown and Southsea, operating four 25-minute crossings every Tuesday and Thursday from 14 July to 27 August.
A 30-year-old man was arrested and released on police bail after a victim was set upon by up to eight men in the Heights area at about 02:00 BST on Sunday.

The death toll from India's recent floods doubled over the last two days to over 100, affecting 450,000 people, particularly in Assam, where millions across at least 20 states in India have been impacted, as the government prepares aid packages and Prime Minister Narendra Modi visits the affected areas.
Arsenal will host Leicester City on Friday 11 August at 19:45 BST as the Premier League starts its 25th anniversary season.
Oldham Athletic Football Club dismissed Cristian Montano after a thorough investigation into his conduct related to allegations of spot-fixing, led by the National Crime Agency.
A 20-year-old man was given a suspended jail term and supervision order for starting a fire at the former Pontins resort in Brixham in June 2014, which destroyed the site.
Wilson, a 30-year-old footballer, rejoined Forest from Celtic in August 2013 but has been without a team since being released in May.

Faulkner took 3-45, dismissing Kusal Perera and key players Angelo Mathews and Thisara Perera, while Amila Aponso took 4-18 as Sri Lanka won the match by 82 runs, leveling the five-match series at 1-1.
Sale Sharks' forward Vadim Cobilas is moving to Bordeaux after deciding to leave the Premiership club this summer.

India collapsed from 277-1 to 323 all out, despite Shikhar Dhawan and Virat Kohli making hundreds, as Australia's Kane Richardson took 5-68, ultimately securing a 25-run victory and a 4-0 series lead.

The Hammersmith and City Line and part of the Circle Line have been suspended due to a fire in a nearby 24-storey building, which posed a short-term risk of debris falling onto the tracks at the request of the London Fire Brigade, partly due to the fire and partly because of planned engineering work.
Jamie Hamill has signed a three-year contract with Kilmarnock, returning to the club where he will make his second debut and 150th appearance, keeping him there until 2017.
Ipswich fan Ross Morgan accidentally punched a hole in his ceiling while celebrating a goal scored by Paul Anderson in the Ipswich v Norwich match, but Anderson offered to pay for the repairs.

Retailers in Wales are now required to keep cigarettes out of public view unless customers request them, with shop managers and assistants facing fines and prison time if they fail to comply, a move backed by Public Health Wales and supported by officials who believe it will reduce the appeal of smoking.
Lucas, a 20-year-old forward, has had two previous spells with the National League side this season, scoring three goals in 10 appearances.

Network Rail is undertaking maintenance work at Knaresborough station, including repairs to the station's watertightness and the removal and rebuilding of the signal box's chimney stack, as well as night-time work on the platform canopy.

Lawrence Phillips, a former star NFL player who played for the St Louis Rams, Miami Dolphins, and San Francisco 49ers, was found dead in his cell at the age of 40, with officials believing he took his own life after serving a term of more than 30 years for his convictions, including assaulting a group of teenagers and his former girlfriend.

The Belfast Rapid Transit (BRT) plan, built upon in 2012, proposes extending bus lane priorities from 07:00 to 19:00, originally considered in 2012, to ensure maximum compliance and avoid confusion, with potential flexibility and community consultation on loading and unloading windows.

Lionel Messi scored the winner in Barcelona's match, securing his 287th La Liga goal and extending his lead as the competition's all-time top scorer on the same day Cristiano Ronaldo became Real Madrid's record league scorer.

Italian prosecutors have arrested and are investigating over 70 people, including club officials and players, in a match-fixing inquiry led by the Catanzaro prosecutors, who uncovered an alleged network involving club presidents, coaches, and some management members, with some suspects linked to mafia organisations, including the 'Ndrangheta crime syndicate, while police are studying suspicious results in dozens of matches.

Approximately 1,600 Dolomedes plantarius spiderlings, a hybrid between species found in Sussex and Suffolk, were released into Castle Marshes to establish a new population with increased genetic variability to help it adapt to climate change.
The Partition of India in 1947 led to the independence of two new countries and resulted in millions of people becoming refugees.
Iva Barr, a seasoned marathon runner, tackled the first 14 miles of the London Marathon before walking the final part to the finish line, describing the experience as "wonderful".
In China's top cities, couples are undergoing fake divorces to buy additional homes due to the extremely high demand and unaffordable property prices.
A 46-year-old man, Mr Jones, died at The Blossoms in Holyhead, prompting a police investigation and the arrest of a 24-year-old man on suspicion of murder.
This message provides contact information for the BBC News Entertainment team, inviting viewers to follow them on social media and share story suggestions.
Two drivers, Scott Kennedy, 46, and Antony Sztuka, 50, both from Ayrshire, died in a car collision involving a red Ford Fiesta and a white Asda delivery van at Drumjohn, near Carsphairn.

Australian rower Sarah Tait, who won a silver medal in the women's pair at the 2012 London Olympics, was a strong role model and inspirational figure to many young athletes before her diagnosis with cervical cancer in 2013.

A suicide bomber hit an army bus in western Kabul, largely destroying the bus, while another blast occurred elsewhere in the city, injuring two soldiers and two civilians, as the Taliban claimed responsibility for the attacks amid a newly signed deal allowing US troops to stay in the country.
Daimler predicted full-year sales to exceed 100 billion euros, reporting a 6% increase in second-quarter unit sales to 527,600 cars and commercial vehicles.
A lifeguard saved the 10-year-old son of Crown Prince Frederik from a rip current at Mermaid Beach.

A fire in Elgin Road at its junction with Inchbroom Road resulted in the discovery of the body of an elderly man found inside, with police investigating the incident at approximately 16:10 on Wednesday and initial inquiries suggesting no suspicious circumstances.

The Defence Medical Rehabilitation Centre (DMRC) based in Surrey has established a clinic to provide specialized treatment to veterans with amputation-related medical issues, mirroring the NHS's tertiary referral system.

Over 125 drivers per day were caught by four speed cameras on a Welsh section of the M4 in their first week of operation, with the number of drivers caught decreasing from a pilot period that saw around 700 drivers caught daily.

A Manchester-born teacher, suspected of a "special obsession" with a girl he taught, was arrested in Spain as part of an Interpol investigation, which discovered illegal files sent from a Spanish email address, into using a cloud storage service to share images of children, including those secretly taken of his students.
A sturgeon named Steve, who escaped from a water centre in Romsey, Hampshire during floods, was discovered in a puddle near a nearby car wash, reportedly "only a little worse for wear."

Chris Rock, 49, has filed for divorce from his wife of nearly 20 years, Malaak Compton-Rock, as confirmed through a statement issued through his lawyer, while the couple, who have two daughters together, Lola Simone and Zahra Savannah, requests privacy as they navigate the process.

A collision on the motorway at Tamnamore has caused the motorway to be closed in both directions, prompting police to advise motorists heading south to Belfast to exit at junction 15 and those heading to Enniskillen in County Fermanagh to exit at junction 12 and travel via Armagh city.

The French government has proposed senior diplomat Laurent Stefanini as its new ambassador to the Vatican, which is yet to approve the choice, amid speculation that the nomination may be rejected due to France's liberal stance on homosexuality.

The Nasdaq suffered its largest one-day decline since April 10 last year, shedding 2.4%, or 118 points, to close at 4,876 after a decline, despite Kraft Foods' shares soaring more than 35% following its merger with Heinz.
Vondrousova defeated Kontaveit in the final, moving her close to the top 100, and Coric saved five match points to win his first ATP title at the Grand Prix Hassan II.

Stoke City has signed Eric Choupo-Moting, their fourth signing of the summer, after a previous attempt to bring him to the club four years ago, who has made 200 Bundesliga appearances and represented Cameroon in the 2010 World Cup.

Seamus McCollum, a 56-year-old man, died at a private nursing home in Randalstown in September, with the investigation initially concluding as a non-murder until an April autopsy led to further questioning.

Heavy rains, triggered by a depression in the Bay of Bengal, have caused widespread flooding in Tamil Nadu, India, and Sri Lanka, disrupting daily life, forcing the evacuation of around 10,000 people from Chennai, and affecting at least 80,000 people in Sri Lanka, prompting a relief fund of 5 billion rupees.
A bus caught fire on the A760 Kilbirnie Road just outside Largs at about 13:35 on Saturday, with the driver's quick actions enabling all passengers to be safely evacuated without injuries.

Nottinghamshire's Jake Ball is in fantastic form, having taken six wickets in each of Notts' first two games, and is the leading wicket-taker in Division One of the County Championship so far in 2016, with his assured early showings with the new ball.

A memorial stone was unveiled in the French village of Guillemont to honor the island's role in World War I, with a core of the stone, made from Jersey granite, being returned to Jersey to become part of a monument in Royal Square.
A 24-year-old who played stormtrooper Finn in Star Wars: The Force Awakens visited his former theatre company, Theatre Peckham, where he was a member from age nine to 14.

Thailand's Aphibarnrat and England's Fitzpatrick are tied at 12 under after the first round of the European Tour event, with England's Luke Donald and several other players, including Lee Westwood, within five strokes of the lead.
Middlesex ended day one of the County Championship match against Hampshire in a strong position, with Voges unbeaten on 128 alongside John Simpson, having formed a third-wicket partnership.

A 52-year-old woman died and a 16-year-old boy is in a critical condition after an incident on Penilee Road, with a 54-year-old man wanted for questioning now located in the Dumfries and Galloway area.

A three-bedroom house in Wavertree, where a member of The Beatles, possibly born in 1935 or another unconfirmed year, lived as a child, sold to an anonymous telephone bidder after a bidding war for a price between £150,000 and £250,000.
A man, Aaron Joseph, has denied being the owner of a dog that caused injury while dangerously out of control in a public place, with a trial set for 5 February.

A body found on private land near Leighton, about 10 miles (16.09km) away from the centre of Shrewsbury, has been confirmed to be that of 22-year-old Thomas Bebbington, who was last seen entering a river at about 19:20 GMT on November 10, and was discovered on Monday.
Five-week-old otter babies, who are doing well, are expected to be able to survive on their own in the summer, at which time they will be moved to a large, outdoor enclosure with a pool.

Police are seeking witnesses to a disturbance at a bonfire on Dakota Avenue in Newtownards and potential activity around the home of Joanne Thompson, a 33-year-old mother of four who was found at her home on Wednesday.

Approximately 2,270 black-tailed godwits were spotted in a tiny field on the island of Kilmoluaig this spring, nearly double the previous record, with many expected to refuel in the Hebrides before continuing on to Iceland for breeding.
Durrant, a player who spent 14 years at Rangers, will not return to the team after manager Mark Warburton decides to alter the coaching personnel.
A rare albino deer has drawn significant attention from visitors after its unusual birth, estimated to occur once every 100,000 births.

Asad Khan, a student at Beckfoot Upper Heaton School in Bradford, died three weeks after starting school, with his family claiming he was bullied, after his mother forcibly entered his locked bedroom, where he had reportedly told a boy that he felt "unsafe" and that "life is 90 to 95 per cent hard".

A painting of the 1654 coronation ceremony, which is the only known representation of the event and has been at Rokeby Park since 1880, has been restored and is now being studied and valued, with experts unable to determine its origin or who painted it.
Macclesfield Town secured a 3-0 win over Wrexham, with Danny Rowe, Mitch Hancox, and Danny Whitaker scoring for the visitors.

Total, a French oil and gas company, takes over from mobile phone company Orange as the new headline sponsor of 10 competitions, starting with the 2017 Africa Cup of Nations finals in Gabon, but the value of the deal remains undisclosed.

Spain's coach, Vicente del Bosque's replacement, has named the squad for the friendly against Belgium and the first World Cup qualifier against Liechtenstein, recalling players such as Diego Costa and Juan Mata after they were left out of the Euro 2016 squad.

A large wildfire, believed to have been started deliberately, was first reported at about 11:00 BST on Sunday, and has spread across a 5-kilometre area, crossing the border, with authorities, including those from the Irish Fire Service, appealing to the public to stop the reckless behaviour of individuals who are still starting fires, which is the latest of 435 reported wildfires since the beginning of May.

Boyd Rankin has rejoined Ireland, citing the country's potential to gain Test status as a key factor in his decision, and will be available to play in the InterContinental Cup match with Papua New Guinea from 31 January to 3 February.
The Northern Ireland Rare Disease Partnership aims to provide an independent voice and lobby for education, special services, and support on behalf of those affected by rare diseases.

Gloucester Cathedral plans to introduce girl choristers to its choir, which was established by Henry VIII in 1539, in an effort to make the choir more inclusive by recruiting from a range of backgrounds and discover talented young singers.
Pedro, a Chelsea winger, suffered a head injury in a game in Beijing and is expected to wear a protective mask when he returns to training.
Nottinghamshire has appointed former England cricketer James Taylor and ex-Northants captain David Sales to provide guidance and share their cricket experiences with the county's batsmen.

A man has been charged with multiple offenses, including assault on police, disorderly behaviour, criminal damage, and was due to appear at Belfast Magistrates Court on 5 December, after an incident on the Whiterock Road in Belfast on a Friday afternoon at 15:00 GMT, witnessed by people including children.
A volunteer crew from the Larne RNLI launched two lifeboats, one of which towed a yacht to Carrick Marina after its engine failed a mile north east of Muck Island.

Ipswich Town secured a 3-2 win over MK Dons, with Varney's header sealing the victory, after Revell levelled from the spot and then equalised with a poke home, with Brett Pitman previously restoring Ipswich's lead.

A man from Darlington has been issued a summons to face charges of dangerous driving, causing serious injury by dangerous driving, and three counts of criminal damage related to a motorway bridge collapse near Maidstone, which injured a motorcyclist with broken ribs but caused no fatalities.

Bystanders in Platja d'Aro, Spain, panicked after mistaking selfie sticks for weapons during a situation where people pretended to be chasing a celebrity, resulting in 11 people being treated for injuries.

Jeremiah Regis, a two-and-a-half-year-old boy, was found injured with over 100 injuries, including a bite to the chest, in High Street, Wednesfield, on November 20, before being pronounced dead in hospital on November 21, with his caregivers, Sindyann Regis and Chevaze Mcgregor, charged with his murder.

A large gorse fire on Woodbury Common, which began at about 13:45 BST, has engulfed a significant area of dry heath-land, with 20 fire engine crews battling the flames on multiple fronts and nearby residents evacuated as a precaution, with firefighters expected to remain on the scene overnight and into the early hours of Monday morning.
Chairman Keith Chapman and a Leicester Speedway statement announced that an agreement has been reached to keep the Leicester Speedway club going, with a 15-year lease signed for the team's venue.

Charles Gordon, Elizabeth Bowe's brother, has been charged with her murder after she was found badly injured and later died at a hospital in Dundee, following a police response that began at her home.

Ross County has signed Jim O'Brien on a two-year contract, with the former Celtic and Motherwell player returning to the club after making 18 appearances and scoring twice during his six-month loan stint last season.
Northants took a strong grip on the match against Durham, bowling them out for 59-3 in 45.2 overs and ending the day 59 runs behind.

Taiwanese golfer Ko is one shot behind joint leaders Brooke Henderson and Lee Mi-rim after two rounds at the Sahalee Country Club in Seattle, with only five players under par at the halfway stage of the second women's major.

Watson, a 56-year-old former Scotland international and coach with experience working under Alex McLeish and coaching Birmingham City, Hibernian, Motherwell, and Rangers, has joined the national team as assistant to manager Gordon Strachan, marking his second stint in the coaching set-up.
Belfast Giants secured a win over the Giants' next opponents, with goals from Colin Shields, Ryan Martinelli, Mark Garside, Alex Foster, and Steve Saviano.
Danny Willett became the first Englishman since Faldo to win the Masters, after Jordan Spieth had a quadruple-bogey seven on the par-three 12th hole.

The BBC's England's Big Picture invites viewers to submit their photographs via email, Facebook, Twitter, or Instagram, with a royalty-free, non-exclusive license granted to the BBC for publication and other use worldwide.

A UK optometrist, Honey Rose, is on trial for gross negligence manslaughter after allegedly failing to detect a life-threatening condition during a routine eye test that led to the death of a patient in July 2012.

China's food price inflation rose to 4.9% in June, surpassing analysts' expectations, which may reduce the likelihood of interest rate cuts and supports a neutral monetary policy, with economic growth expected to be 7.5%, the slowest rate in 23 years.

Ivory Coast international and former Newcastle player Cheick Tiote, 30, died after collapsing during training for Beijing Enterprises in February, attended by friends, family, and former teammates, and later honored at a memorial service.
Orica-Scott rider Yates' absence led to Slovak Sagan winning an uphill sprint, moving Thibaut Pinot to second overall behind leader Nairo Quintana.

Cuadrilla's plans for fracking at its Preston New Road site in Lancashire, approved in October, aim to prioritize the county for job creation, skills development, and community investment despite an ongoing legal challenge and a commitment to spend up to half of the estimated £50m exploration phase budget in Lancashire.

Two 17-year-old and one 19-year-old males from north-west London, who were suspected of planning to travel to Syria, were stopped by Turkish officials on their return to the UK and later released without charge after further inquiries.
A hospital spokesperson at the Royal Berkshire Hospital firmly rejected a £1,000 quote for a blind, which was later purchased from Homebase for £22.95.

Swansea's development squad celebrated 31 wins across all competitions in 2016-17, including a cup final win, after Swansea's senior team survived in the Premier League following Crystal Palace beating Hull 4-0.

A report suggests that the dunes at Barkby Beach in Prestatyn are beginning to re-establish themselves naturally after severe storms caused damage, but the council is considering creating a secondary dune system to strengthen defences.

The BBC will broadcast a live game from the 2017-18 FA Cup, featuring South Shields, who will host a match on August 19, with commentary from Conor McNamara and Danny Webber, and the game will be available live on PC, mobile, connected TV, and on BBC iPlayer, with audience interaction possible via the #bbcfacup hashtag.
A 38-year-old man was attacked on Craigmillar Castle Road, suffering serious facial injuries, while a 49-year-old man was also present at the scene.

Pamela McLaggan, 51, pleaded guilty to manslaughter after Jonathan Baines, 44, was found dead at a house in Gainsborough on 1 August, having been out at Market Rasen races and visiting pubs in the town before his death.

A 15-year-old boy was punched and stamped on at Patterton station at about 23:30, suffering facial injuries, after an altercation with a group of older people, and his mobile phone was stolen, shortly before the train arrived at Patterton.

Two 17-year-old boys from Dewsbury, Hassan Munshi and Talha Asmal, are being investigated by West Yorkshire Police and counter-terrorism officers for allegedly being feared to have travelled to Syria to join Islamic State in March, after being questioned under section 5 of the Terrorism Act and later bailed.
The Great Britain national ice hockey team has announced a 22-man squad for the final qualifying tournament, featuring several experienced players including Jonathan Boxill and Stephen Murphy.
Matthew Perry may tape something for a tribute to the show's creator James Burrows, which is airing on NBC on 21 February.
Jones, a 31-year-old footballer, made 41 league appearances last season for Burnley, helping the team win the Championship title, and has played for several other clubs including Manchester United.

The body of Melbourne lawyer Joe Acquaro, who represented clients including crime bosses accused of extortion, drugs, and arms offences, was found outside a cafe he owned, with investigators suspecting an underworld motive.

Air France flight AF374 from Paris CDG to Vancouver was diverted to Glasgow Prestwick due to a slight smell of burning on board, where it landed normally before passengers were flown back to Charles de Gaulle Airport.
Coastal areas and north-western parts of Wales are expected to see the worst of the weather as the remains of Hurricane Gonzalo reach Britain, bringing strong winds and heavy rain.
People are worried that hospitals are becoming overcrowded, potentially affecting children who get injured and need to be seen by a doctor.

A 64-year-old man, Kenneth David Dickie, died from a head injury sustained on Saturday at Southampton General Hospital, and two individuals, a 34-year-old man charged with grievous bodily harm and a 57-year-old woman bailed until July on suspicion of grievous bodily harm with intent and perverting the course of justice, are connected with his death.
Ex-Manchester United forward Matteo Macheda will stay at the City Ground on loan until the end of the season.

The body of Christopher Huxtable, a 34-year-old man from Swansea, has been found after being missing since the partial collapse of a building due for demolition in February, bringing closure to his family, but two other men, Ken Cresswell, 57, and John Shaw, 61, both from Rotherham, remain missing, along with Michael Collings, 53, whose body was previously recovered.
Bristol City head coach Lee Johnson emphasizes the importance of beating QPR, citing it as a crucial game that could significantly impact their position in the league standings.
Luca, an ESA astronaut, described his experience as "absolutely fantastic" after participating in two spacewalks and orbiting the Earth 2,656 times.

Joe Arundel, an England Knights player, has joined Hull FC, citing excitement and nerves about the new challenge, with the club's director of rugby, Shaun McRae, highlighting Arundel's promise and potential for future success.

Ulster Bank, a subsidiary of RBS, is working to resolve a payment issue affecting around 600,000 customers, with a promise that no customers will be left out of pocket, with efforts to update these payments expected to be completed by Saturday, and the bank having invested hundreds of millions of pounds to improve its computer systems since the 2012 IT meltdown.
Tanzania led Kenya in the 2016 Women's Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers, while Ethiopia defeated Uganda 4-1 in the play-off for third place.
McDonald's Japan is rationing French fries due to a delay in potato imports caused by industrial action in America, with over 1,000 tonnes of potatoes already flown in to boost supplies.
The total purse for the Classic on June 3 has increased to £1.625m with the addition of new entrants, while John Jenkins defends his decision to run the 1,000-1 outsider Diore Lia.

Atletico Madrid's 25-year-old top scorer Antoine Griezmann, who trails Real by six points after 11 games in La Liga, will miss France's friendly due to a haematoma on his left foot, but a bone injury was ruled out after an X-ray.
Veteran prop Willie Mason, who played 290 NRL games and won the 2004 Premiership with Canterbury, has joined a Super League team coached by Laurent Frayssinous.
A recent survey by The Marine Conservation Society found an overall 11% increase in dog mess on UK beaches, with a significant 71% rise in Scotland.

The Supreme Court ruled that the government's introduction of fees for employment tribunal cases in 2013, which led to a 79% reduction in claims over three years, was indirectly discriminatory to women and unconstitutional, describing it as a "tremendous victory" for employment rights.
Wycombe secured a win over Dagenham, moving them up to sixth spot, while Dagenham remain in the relegation places.

Bee-eaters, native to southern Europe, successfully bred in the UK for a second consecutive summer, with two pairs raising chicks at Low Gelt Quarry near Brampton, where they were discovered among a colony of nesting sand martins and are expected to leave the nest in about four weeks, burrowing up to 10ft and laying clutches of four to nine eggs.

A boy jumped into the River Wey in Guildford to try and save his father after his father's vessel capsized, but the public shouted for him to come back, and a search operation is underway for a missing kayaker.

A girl visiting Rabat Zoo in Morocco was fatally injured by a stone thrown by an elephant from its enclosure, which the zoo said was rare and unpredictable, and experts attributed to the animal possibly exhibiting frustration.

Labour MP Ms Glass has been appointed shadow minister for Europe and a shadow junior education minister, succeeding Ms Powell, who resigned citing Mr Corbyn's position as "untenable" due to lack of confidence in his leadership.

Chelsea manager Conte believes five teams, including second-placed Tottenham, third-placed Manchester City, fourth-placed Arsenal, fifth-placed Liverpool, and Manchester United, have a strong chance of winning the title with 14 games remaining.

A dispersal order has been issued in Llangefni, allowing police to force troublemakers to leave the area, with the action being twofold: to protect young people from the excesses of alcohol and its potential consequences, and to take positive action against youths causing anti-social behaviour.
Chelsea midfielder Lewis Baker is a target for an unnamed Championship club, with manager Garry Monk confirming the club's interest in signing him.

The Roald Dahl Funny Prize, established in 2008 by former children's laureate Michael Rosen, book charity Booktrust, and the Roald Dahl literary estate, is expected to have a "robust future" for the unique celebration of humorous children's books.

Frazier Glenn Miller Jr, a 74-year-old white supremacist, was convicted of capital murder and other charges, and sentenced to death for the murders of three people (William Corporon, 69, Reat Griffin Underwood, 14, and Terri LaManno, 53) outside Jewish sites in Kansas.

The city council plans to launch a large-scale self-service bike scheme in April 2017, with 500 bikes located across the city, and will be financed through sponsorship income and at no cost to the taxpayer.
West Ham's 27-year-old Diaf is undergoing a personal pre-season training schedule after undergoing back surgery and three months of rehab.

The NI Residential Property Price Index reported a 5.4% annual price increase in the third quarter, with the average standardised price reaching just over £124,000, and notable fluctuations compared to the previous year in council districts and property types, as well as a relatively low 0.8% price increase compared to the second quarter.

A delivery of a huge wind turbine part on the A713 in Dumfries and Galloway recently ended in a lorry and its cargo going into a ditch, following a different outcome than a successful delivery at Bargrennan Bridge in November.

The Betsi Cadwaladr health board is considering downgrading services at one of the area's three district hospitals due to staffing shortages, but is facing opposition from residents who are concerned about the impact on local maternity care.
South Africa's Mignon du Preez scored 116 off 99 balls as her team reached a total of 272-6 against Ireland.
Peake, a 30-year-old Welsh athlete, aims to break the Welsh record she currently holds and qualify for Team GB in the Rio Olympics by achieving a standard of 4.50m.
A fire that burned for over 10 hours at a building site in Bloomery Circle, Llanwern, in the Gwent area, is believed to have been deliberately set.

A charity event, organised by Mercy Corps with help from the Nepal Scotland Association and the city council, was held in the city to raise money and show support for the relief efforts following the devastating earthquake in Nepal.
Uefa's control, ethics and disciplinary body imposed a suspension on Hibernian head coach Neil Lennon for "acts of violence against the referee".
A fire broke out at the ICL UK Boulby mine on April 13, resulting in seven workers being taken to hospital and treated for smoke inhalation, and prompting a Health and Safety Executive investigation.

Two men, including a 23-year-old British national, were removed from a Unesco World Heritage site, believed to be Machu Picchu, after being caught posing naked by surveillance workers, but have not been arrested or charged.

Croatia international Ivan Rakitic is set to sign a new deal with Barcelona on Friday, with a £109m buyout clause, after making 145 appearances for the club since his 2014 move, with his current contract running until 2019 and scoring 23 goals.

A couple from Halstead suffered "life-changing" injuries during a break-in at their home on April 26, where they were subjected to "two hours of torture" and threatened with harm to their family members.

The Wickerman Festival, held at East Kirkcarswell Farm near Dundrennan on July 25 and 26, will feature a diverse lineup including Dizzee Rascal, Martha Reeves, The Zombies, Big Country, and The Feeling.

Foden expressed hope that his strong performances with Saints would push England rugby to a good place, and that his team's success would result in several players being selected for the upcoming Six Nations tournament.
A 22-year-old motorcyclist died after a collision with a Vauxhall Zafira car in Dagenham, where he was taken to hospital, while two other children in the car suffered minor injuries.
Pfizer has agreed to acquire Anacor Pharmaceuticals, the developer of eczema cream crisaborole, which could reach $2bn in annual sales if approved by US regulators.

Two teenage boys, aged 17 and 15, were arrested in Dagenham after police recovered several knives, scissors, and cannabis from a "large and unpredictable" crowd following reports of a street fight on Saturday.
A 23-year-old man from Cardiff was arrested on suspicion of sexual assault after a 19-year-old woman was attacked in the Gorsedd Gardens area near Cardiff Civic Centre.
John Lamont, a Conservative MSP, has resigned from the Berwickshire, Roxburgh and Selkirk constituency seat to run for a Westminster seat against the SNP's Calum Kerr.

The UK and Ireland, among other countries, can now sell beef to Canada, as part of a growing trend to recognize the EU's robust measures to eradicate BSE, following the impact of a Russian import ban and weaker Chinese demand on the EU's farm exports.
Finance ministers have endorsed the move to create a single EU list of "non-cooperative jurisdictions," which is to be completed by the end of the summer.

Archaeologists discovered pottery fragments, kiln remains used for drying grain, and Bronze Age burnt mounds during excavations at Torvean for the construction of the West Link road in Inverness, with some items displayed at Lochardil Primary School.
Main scored the winning goal for Oldham after the hour mark, securing victory and maintaining Oldham's cushion above the League One relegation places.

Lally, a renowned Irish actor, passed away peacefully after a short illness, leaving behind a legacy in film and television, including notable roles in the play Translations, Glenroe, and The Secret of Kells.

Derby City Council committed to keeping Moorways Pool open for a year after finding Â£350,000 in savings, but its long-term future remains uncertain due to potential future funding issues, with plans for a new 50m pool to be built by 2018 and approximately 1,200 young people using the facility every week.

Human rights groups, including UNICEF, are concerned that children detained by the Nigerian army in the fight against Boko Haram, who are held in a military barracks in the north-eastern city of Maiduguri, may not be going through a proper legal process.
